the report opens mid-text with «قال ابن شهاب» and no compiler's shaykh is written; «يقولون» (people) is not a link; the first-person narrative («وسأخبركم عن ذلك») is Abu Hurayra's own words, so he is the last link
The report opens with «قال ابن شهاب» and no shaykh is written: the chain is read as it stands, from Ibn Shihab.
«وقال ابن المسيب إن أبا هريرة قال» makes Ibn al-Musayyab and then Abu Hurayra links. Abu Hurayra's own words («ولقد قال رسول الله») make him last.
«يقولون» is what people say: not links.
